The row y=3 is a wall except at x=11. So the only way up is through (11,3), which is directly above the rock at (11,4). I need to reach (11,3) — but the rock blocks the tile below it. Let me check if I can approach (11,3) from (12,3) or (10,3)... those are walls. So (11,3) is only reachable from (11,2) above or (11,4) below (rock).

Wait — maybe the rock can be broken with the hoe. Let me try using the hoe on the rock.
